Aware Health | ONSITE Hybrid 3 days/wk in San Francisco | Full time | https://awarehealth.io

Come build the future of orthopedic care with us! I'm expanding my team again at Aware Health, and I'm hiring a Director of Engineering to help us develop innovative AI agents and AI-powered product solutions in healthcare.

We’re a rapidly growing startup on a mission to deliver high-quality, $0 orthopedic care to people across the U.S.

If you (or someone you know) has expertise in Golang, TypeScript, Python, and a strong desire to build AI in healthcare, please apply or share: https://www.awarehealth.io/careers/dir-of-engineering

Why Aware Health?

→ An MSK product that works — led by our CEO, a world-leading researcher in Direct Access MSK outcomes (NPS: 91+)

→ Real momentum — we’ve more than doubled revenue and covered lives 2 years in a row

→ A small but mighty product team (product, data, engineering, AI)

→ A culture of meritocracy and high-performance (work with smart, driven colleagues)

Mention Hacker News in your application.
